cards.name: Basic Skill
cards.meaning: Novice utility skill. Public source checks its level for trade requests, emotions, sitting, chatroom creation and party creation when battle_config.basic_skill_check is enabled, with alternate skill checks and other restrictions. This does not establish the current server setting, permanent ownership or permission to act; GM permissions and other server conditions remain separate.
